name: Ku'gath Plaguefather
canonNotes: A Great Unclean One fascinated by breeding new and virulent life; he means to one day brew a contagion that can infect the Gods themselves.
Rides a palanquin laden with alchemical vials and sacks of Nurglings, carried by straining Nurglings.
voiceNotes: Gloomy, grandfatherly and fussy about his 'recipes'.
Offers diseases as gifts; oddly warm, deeply unsettling.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
